Use the run_workflow tool to start the saved workspace recipe twice, by workflowPath, with no model override and no workflowPrompt. Do not read source files, edit files or run shell commands yourself.
Run 1: workflowPath "<REVIEW_CHECKOUT>/.kiro/workflows/independent-release-review.workflow.json", inputs {"expected_sha": "2fcf39b7fe4db6f78cb33f6b2c474e053e89bbc7"}, runLabel "independent-release-review-bad-sha".
Run 2: same workflowPath, inputs {"expected_sha": "c529330dc724108d72035f9bc46ba726a0612d8a"}, runLabel "independent-release-review-showdown-c529330dc724108d72035f9bc46ba726a0612d8a".
Then wait for both runs to reach a terminal state from their notifications (do not poll with sleep). Answer with each workflowId, its terminal status and the last line of each step's report.
